proof_relation: finite directed word reachability over arbitrary finite alphabets and rules

conformance.domain: doubled integer grid centers with fixed finite rectangle roots
conformance.occupancy: one at each center; four edge midpoint values
conformance.inventory: four disjoint Cartesian blocks exhaust zero/one-head triples; no materialized million-type list
conformance.incidence: complete symbolic center domains; (center,triple) reverse incidence is its unique center
conformance.scheduler: global dead, global forced, earliest generation; root ties by row then column
conformance.rollback: trail restores selected cells, all marks including new distant dependencies, domains, order and generations
conformance.proposal: learned word-rule singleton/two-move sequences; independently validated proof compiles to tile preferences
conformance.execution: every preferred tile still uses the global graph scheduler; all base alternatives retained
conformance.marking_control: analytic redundant neighbor-value assignment, not a learned failure marking
conformance.unknown: every node/time/stage-limited non-success is unknown; no unprovability inference

marking_lemma.hypothesis: complete standard Wang rectangle; blank side pairs
marking_lemma.assignment: tile (a,b,c) also assigns a,c at the bottom-value points of its left/right neighbors
marking_lemma.reason: horizontal W=(a,b), E=(b,c) equalities already imply a=S_left and c=S_right; exterior side values are blank
marking_lemma.conclusion: the extended marking preserves every complete solution; finite prefixes can be pruned sooner

limitations: first-order Hilbert kernel to this executable checker remains open
finite compiler tests and independent semantic certificates are not a formally verified compiler
tiny held-out rewrite problems do not establish performance on general mathematical proofs
turtle substitution and Penrose hierarchical subsystem remain open

training.cold_start: zero weights; no certificate, saved policy, proof witness or proof-specific move sequence imported

universality_reduction.scope: finite example checks the arbitrary-TM reduction; universality follows from the general transition forms and configuration invariant
universality_reduction.transition_shapes: stay, left/right interior moves, left/right blank border extension, halt-only erasure
universality_reduction.invariant: one state marker and preserved L/R delimiters before halt; only halt marker enables ACCEPT cleanup

fairness.schedule: at stage s, all powers-of-two bounds with exponent sum at most s and node budget 2**s
fairness.proof: any finite derivation fits some capacity and padded certificate; its accepting computation fits a larger power-of-two height. This fixed triple recurs at every later stage with unbounded node budget; finite complete DFS eventually covers its proof
fairness.implementation: fair_search; unlimited execution has no wall-clock cutoff; bounded example is unknown
fairness.truth_scope: semidecides derivability in the declared word theory; does not decide arbitrary truth or terminate on every negative

independent_audit.trusted_boundary: fixed theory, statements and bounds imported independently; proofs cannot register their own axioms or target
independent_audit.paths: independent directed word semantics, operational TM replay and all point sums/agreement; no symbolic domain code

semantic_tests.scope: full turtle, Penrose, logic, generic proof and first-class cluster semantic suite
